cover.woman_bio: Seventeenth-century ruler of the Ndongo and Matamba kingdoms in what is now Angola, remembered for her diplomacy and her long resistance to Portuguese colonial expansion.
cover.quote: I am not a woman who retreats. I am a woman who advances.
cover.quote_source: attributed; see John K. Thornton, Warfare in Atlantic Africa (1999)
pomodoro_overview: Check-in (2 min): how you feel and how the iPad feels
Reading & Writing (6 min): main idea and sentences

content.content: There are no right answers here. Tap one number for each. Your answers help me make the iPad work better for you.

content.question: How stressed do you feel right now?
How is your energy right now?
How easy is it to read and tap on the iPad?
Is there anything about the room or the iPad that is getting in the way today? (Write “nothing” if not.)

content.content: Work on scrap paper if you need to, then type the answer. Type numbers only (no % or QAR signs needed).

content.question: In a class the ratio of boys to girls is 4:3 and there are 28 students. How many girls are there?
Change 7/16 into a percent. Keep every decimal place.
A price falls from QAR 80 to QAR 68. What is the percent decrease?
Notebooks cost QAR 24 each. You buy 3 and get 15% off the TOTAL. How much do you pay?
In your own words, type the steps you used for Question 4.

content.content: Many students think the best way to prepare for a test is to study all night. Research on memory suggests the opposite. While a person sleeps, the brain sorts the day’s learning and stores the important parts. A student who studies for two hours and then sleeps well often remembers more than a student who studies until sunrise. Good preparation, then, includes rest.

content.question: What is the main idea of the passage?
choices: A) Studying for two hours is too long.
B) Sleep helps the brain store what you learn, so rest is part of good preparation.
C) Tests are easier in the morning.

content.question: Which of these is a complete sentence?
choices: A) Even though she studied late into the night.
B) Walking to the exam centre with her notes.
C) The student slept well before the exam.
D) Because the brain stores learning during sleep.

content.question: Fix this fragment so it is a complete sentence: Because the bus was late.

content.content: This checks how typing on the iPad feels. Write 3 to 5 sentences about something that made you proud this week. Complete sentences; check each one for a subject and a verb.
